arguments.summary: Decision: assess whether NVDA or MU has a supportable, differentiated three-month fundamental/risk case relative to QQQ, rather than force a ranking. Grouped Company, Macro, Technical, and Geopolitics assignments have been accepted and collectively cover the material company, market-regime, price-action, and policy channels. Commodities is omitted because no registered commodity-price or supply-cost source is identified and its incremental value is lower than preserving the synthesis reserve.

claims.text: The decision requires separate evaluation of company demand/guidance and valuation assumptions, common macro/market regime, technical behavior, and policy risk against QQQ over 63 sessions; no assessment is supportable until the accepted grouped research returns.

gaps.description: Primary company, macro, technical, and geopolitical research is pending; this currently prevents symbol-level assessment.
No registered commodity-specific source is available to quantify commodity-price or input-cost transmission; commodities research is omitted to preserve the shared final-synthesis budget.

assumptions: QQQ will be analyzed using dated sponsor holdings/profile rather than treated as a single-company earnings stream.
Any valuation sensitivity will use explicitly labeled scenario earnings-per-share and P/E assumptions, not consensus.
arguments.counter_thesis: Company-specific catalysts may be outweighed by a common growth-equity/rates regime or semiconductor policy shock, making QQQ diversification comparatively more resilient.

review_conditions.description: Review the integrated assessment after the accepted Company, Macro, Technical, and Geopolitics findings are available; confirm dated QQQ look-through and any valuation assumptions before a conclusion.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Candidate common exposure to technology/growth-equity market conditions and semiconductor-related demand/policy transmission will be tested by the assigned research.
shared_exposures.qualification: This is a research scope hypothesis, not a quantified holding weight, exposure estimate, or allocation.
